labels.description: Adds a new sentence disclosing that in certain circumstances AT&T could be liable for the actions of its suppliers and other third parties it does business with.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a new exposure (liability for supplier and third-party conduct) is disclosed.

labels.description: The only change is removal of a stray page number (11) from the text; the risk factor wording is identical.
labels.rationale: minor: pagination artifact only, no change in substance.

labels.description: The as-of date rolls forward from December 31, 2024 to December 31, 2025, with the unionized share of the workforce unchanged at approximately 43%.
labels.rationale: minor: routine date roll-forward only; the percentage is unchanged.

labels.description: Scope widens from business transformation initiatives to also cover acquisitions, joint ventures (particularly those aimed at enhancing fiber serviceable locations), dispositions and other strategic transactions, and adds new disclosure that AI-related laws are uncertain and vary by jurisdiction and that AI may not meaningfully enhance products or operations.
labels.rationale: criteria 1, 2 and 3: new risks (transaction execution challenges, AI regulatory uncertainty) and new business activities are disclosed and the scope of the risk factor is widened.

labels.description: Adds injunctions as a possible outcome of litigation or government charges, alongside paying amounts or changing operations.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a new exposure (being subject to injunctions) is disclosed.

labels.description: The consequences of cyberattacks change from hypothetical to realized, from "can cause" equipment failures and data loss that "could result" in expenses and liability to "have caused, and may in the future cause" them and "have and in the future could result" in those harms, alongside a stylistic switch from "the Company" to "we".
labels.rationale: criterion 3: the characterization shifts from hypothetical to realized harm.

labels.description: The only change is a page number (12) inserted mid-paragraph; the risk factor wording is identical.
labels.rationale: minor: pagination artifact only, no change in substance.

labels.description: The debt disclosure changes from "we have incurred debt" to "we intend to and have incurred debt" to fund significant acquisitions and spectrum purchases, and "managing our debt level going forward" becomes "managing our debt level".
labels.rationale: criterion 3: scope widens from past borrowing to a stated intention to incur further acquisition and spectrum debt.

labels.description: Drops the named examples of tax legislation, the U.S. Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 and the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, from the discussion of uncertain application of tax laws (a page number is also added).
labels.rationale: criterion 2: two named regulations previously referenced are dropped.

labels.description: Covered the risk that the IRS could, on audit and despite a favorable Private Letter Ruling, treat the WarnerMedia distribution and related transactions as taxable, exposing AT&T to significant tax liability with any indemnification from Warner Bros. Discovery subject to that company's credit risk.
